maya: posting quick follow-up after yesterday's failover postmortem. We had recurring patterns: stale manifests in snapshots, DNS flap during partial partition, and cache cold-start on write cutover. Need owners + realistic timelines. keep replies short.
oscar: I'll take snapshot automation: weekly dry-restore job + manifest validation. ETA 2026-04-04. blocker: need staging S3 quota bump.

priya: backups owner — I'll run full integrity sweep and propose retention fixes. found two incremental chains with missing manifests; pushing findings. ETA 2026-03-29.

devon: routing + traffic ramp: propose Route53 weighted records + healthcheck gating and a phased cut: 10%->50%->100% with 5m observation windows. I'll draft terraform and playbook. ETA 2026-04-06.

ops-bot: created checklist: https://redwood.internal/incidents/dr/1939990000/checklist and calendar invite: mini-game-day 2026-04-08 14:00-15:30 UTC.

maya: quick runbook notes — ensure steps are idempotent, add a verify-state script (write->read->diff), and include KV warmup step before enabling writes.

oscar: agree, will add verify-state and dry-restore logs to `/incidents/dr-2026-04/backup-logs/`. infra PR will reference this thread.

priya: pushed manifest fixes PR: https://redwood.internal/pr/5801 (WIP). logs at `s3://incidents/dr-2026-03/backup-logs/`.

devon: draft terraform snippet will be in the doc; sample weight plan: eu=70, na=20, ap=10 and healthcheck->failover to NA.

maya: owner summary: snapshot automation — oscar — 2026-04-04; backups verification — priya — 2026-03-29; DNS & ramp — devon — 2026-04-06; mini-game-day — ops-bot — 2026-04-08. react :white_check_mark: when started and paste PR/calendar. weekly check-ins Mondays 09:00 UTC.

oscar: started infra draft and staging job. will ping on S3 quota.

priya: started validation run, will update PR with results.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: weekly-owner-check every Monday 09:00 UTC starting 2026-03-30.

maya: thanks team. I'll keep the tracker and close thread once all items are green. Reopen if blockers surface. :sparkles:
